SELF DECLARATION A SELF DECLARATION IS TO BE SUBMITTED ON THE LETTER HEAD OF THE BIDDER STATING THAT ALL THE ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS MENTIONED IN THE TEXT BASED ATC CLAUSE IS ACCE PTED BY THE BIDDER. 7.
